Area.evidence_source: [/page/6/Text/11] Disclosure was a huge step for all the participants, whether it was with a partner, friend, expert, counsellor or others. When they finally disclosed what had happened, they experienced great positive energy and a new sense of freedom. Some participants experienced valuable support from their loved ones while others would have liked more emotional support. It seemed that the most valuable support came from male buddies who had been through the same experience.
